items.name: 12 Sides of Christmas Lindon 2026
items.information: **This competition is not reccomended for first time competitors** ***Only 1 spectator per competitor is allowed due to space constraints*** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full). If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the Registration and Waitlist Info tab. Go to our [website](https://utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group, Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area! [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBblkvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--78136ba2316603f64144b1e4187349c9f12b5dd9/image.png)](https://utahcubing.org/)

items.name: NoVA Winter Break 2026
items.information: Wednesday, December 23rd: 2x2x2 Cube and 7x7x7 Cube Thursday, December 24th: 6x6x6 Cube and Skewb Friday, December 25th (Christmas): 5x5x5 Cube and Pyraminx Saturday, December 26th: 3x3x3 One-Handed and Clock Sunday, December 27th: 4x4x4 Cube and Square-1 There is a **separate 24-person limit** for each event. If every individual event has already reached its limit, no further registrations will be accepted, even if the overall limit of 40 hasn't been reached.
